probeRepricing.priorEstimateStatus: configuration-table estimate only, not actual billing
probeRepricing.notes: Parent supplied usage. Raw probe not opened here. Under current official implicit-cache minimum, an 89-token request cannot hit the 2048-token minimum. Apply actual account tier and invoice separately.

assumptions: Single completion, exact model and endpoint, standard token postpaid; no non-token services or extra requests.
Published maxima bound all charged input/output including framing and reasoning; conservative independent maxima avoid relying on context/input/output overlap.
Public rates apply as upper bounds to account and remain effective throughout call.
Cash fees, rounding, tax, settlement currency and exchange treatment are separately resolved.
reservationCandidate.note: Use full 384k+128k envelope initially, without changing request body. A tighter 4096+128k envelope requires captured absence of max_completion_tokens, matching server defaults and all-path verification. CNY 8 is not USD 8 and is not an actual bill.

boundaries: Account/order actual rate ceiling, settlement currency, discounts/surcharges/tax and TPM package arrangement; can potentially be obtained via authorized read-only billing/order API or sanitized account export, not by inference from an inference API key.
A binding CNY-to-USD budget conversion rule with fees/validity; a spot market quote alone does not guarantee eventual card settlement.
Existing shared-lineage consumption and outstanding unknown attempts across all hosts/providers. Local new ledger cannot establish remaining USD 99 by itself.
Provider authoritative charge for an interrupted call without usage; retain full reservation until actual request/billing reconciliation.
Whether all runtime paid egress is behind admission and matches pinned product/request identity. This is an implementation/test fact, not a provider console permission issue.

actualTierFollowup.meaning: Response default identifies online regular inference; standard is not asserted as an interchangeable API enum.
